acceptanceCriteria: A paging or --max-commits option reads a range larger than the bound in deterministic parts, each naming its continuation.
The bound or deadline is derived from, or documented against, a measured rate, with the measurement recorded.
body: Residual from V1-1699 (PR #1096, UCL1142-V0-008). The bound was measured at about 20 s for 512 commits on the lane host, so a slower host can still hit the 30 s deadline and refuse with changes-timeout. Wide ranges get only a refusal and no way to read them in parts.
title: changes: 512-commit bound is not a time guarantee; add paging or --max-commits for wide upgrade ranges
